Noxious Weeds & Hazardous Waste
he purpose of this page is to assist property owners in Lyon County with information on the Noxious Weed Law, noxious weeds and the methods to control them. The control of any weed depends a great deal on early detection of it’s presence. This page was assembled to aid in that process.
Records Search
There are two options for searching land records. One is for users who routinely search records in a single county (Laredo). The other is for users who want to search records in all Fidlar counties (Tapestry).
